title: Someone Buys My Bad DAYS 🧾
description:
At Tulley's you can return a bad day before midnight, and it never happened. The fine print says returned days go back on the shelf, and somebody can buy them.

I've returned forty-seven days in two years. Every receipt is stamped sold. Tonight I'm staying after closing to see who's buying them.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment KEEP if you'd keep your bad days.
